news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Steel Hub Banane Ke Liye 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain

Is yojana se textile aur nuclear energy sector ko bhi badhava milega, jisse Bihar ki arthvyavastha ko majbooti milegi

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Milega Vishwashtariya Swaroop
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena shuru kiya hai, jisse yah project vishwabhar mein apni pehchan banayega
Is project ke tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas kiya jayega, jisse yah Bihar ke liye ek mahatvapoorn pariyojana ban jayegi
Is pariyojana se Bihar ke logon ko suvidha aur sujhav milega, jisse unki jeevan shaili mein sudhar aayega
